配置信息过长，请重新复制。: The configuration is too long. Copy it again.
请填写从 BotFather 获取的完整 Bot Token。: Enter the complete Bot Token from BotFather.
请识别接收账号，或填写有效的 Chat ID。: Identify an account or enter a valid Chat ID.
请粘贴完整的 HTTPS 机器人地址。: Paste the complete HTTPS bot URL.
请填写钉钉群机器人地址，地址应包含 access_token。: Enter a DingTalk bot URL containing access_token.
请填写 Slack Incoming Webhook 地址。: Enter a Slack Incoming Webhook URL.
网络连接失败，请检查网络或系统代理。: Connection failed. Check your network or system proxy.
平台响应不完整，尚未确认送达。: The platform response was incomplete. Delivery is unconfirmed.
Slack 未确认送达，请检查 Webhook 和频道权限。: Slack did not confirm delivery. Check the Webhook and channel permissions.
平台响应无法识别，尚未确认送达。: The platform response was not recognized. Delivery is unconfirmed.
平台响应缺少结果，尚未确认送达。: The platform response has no result. Delivery is unconfirmed.
请先填写正确的 Bot Token。: Enter a valid Bot Token first.
无法连接 Telegram，请检查网络和系统代理。: Cannot connect to Telegram. Check your network and system proxy.
无法读取机器人消息，请检查 Token；已绑定其他服务的机器人可能不支持此操作。: Cannot read bot messages. Check the token and whether another service is using this bot.
多个账号使用了此配对码，请重新生成后再试。: Multiple accounts used this code. Generate a new one.
还没有收到配对码。请先私聊机器人发送配对码，再点识别。: No pairing code received. Send it to your bot in a private chat, then identify your account.
系统凭据库无法读取，请重新保存配置。: Cannot read system credentials. Save your configuration again.
请解锁系统凭据库；Linux 需要 libsecret 和可用的 Secret: Unlock the system credential store. Linux requires libsecret and a running Secret Service.
无法删除系统凭据，请解锁凭据库后重试。: Cannot remove credentials. Unlock the credential store and try again.
无法读取渠道凭据，请重新保存配置。: Cannot read channel credentials. Save your configuration again.
超过 24 小时，已停止补发。: Older than 24 hours. No further attempts.
该渠道或提醒类型已关闭。: This channel or notification type is disabled.
渠道凭据不可用，请解锁系统凭据库或重新保存配置。: Channel credentials are unavailable. Unlock the credential store or save the configuration again.
无法读取本地事件队列。: Cannot read the local event queue.
收到时提醒已暂停。: Notifications were paused when this event arrived.
收到时尚未配置通知渠道。: No channels were configured when this event arrived.
发现无法识别的事件，且暂时无法移出队列，请检查数据目录权限和磁盘空间。: An invalid event could not be moved out of the queue. Check folder permissions and disk space.
发现无法识别的事件，已移至 rejected 目录供检查；正常通知继续处理。: An invalid event was moved to the rejected folder. Other notifications continue.
通知记录保存失败，请检查磁盘空间。: Cannot save notification history. Check disk space.
Codex 已禁用本地 Hooks；请先在 Codex 中调整该设置。: Local Hooks are disabled in Codex. Enable them in Codex settings.
安装包缺少事件助手，请重新安装 Nudilo。: The event helper is missing. Reinstall Nudilo.
Codex 配置刚刚发生变化，请重新关联。: Codex settings changed. Reconnect and try again.
当前 Codex 未识别全部三种提醒事件，请升级 Codex 后重试。: This Codex version does not support all notification events. Update Codex and try again.
Nudilo 的事件被 Codex 禁用，请在 Codex 设置中启用后重试。: Nudilo events are disabled. Enable them in Codex settings.
Codex 关联验证未通过，请重试。: Could not verify the Codex connection. Try again.
Codex 未接受事件助手的信任设置。: Codex did not accept the event helper trust settings.
已安装事件监听，等待下一次 Codex 事件。: Event listener installed. Waiting for the next Codex event.
现有 hooks.json 无法解析，已保留原文件。: The existing hooks.json is invalid. The original file was preserved.
现有 Hooks 格式不受支持，已保留原文件。: The existing Hooks format is unsupported. The original file was preserved.
现有 Hook 处理器格式不受支持，已保留原文件。: An existing Hook handler is unsupported. The original file was preserved.
无法启动 Codex，请在高级设置中选择有效的 Codex 程序。: Cannot start Codex. Select a valid executable in Advanced settings.
连接 Codex 超时，请确认它能够正常启动。: Codex connection timed out. Check that Codex can start.
Codex 提前关闭连接；请升级 Codex 后重试。: Codex closed the connection. Update Codex and try again.
还没有找到 Codex 的本地配置，请先安装并使用一次 Codex。: No local Codex configuration found. Install and open Codex first.
未找到 Codex 程序。请先安装 Codex，或在高级设置中指定程序位置。: Codex was not found. Install it or select its executable in Advanced settings.
Codex 程序不存在。: The Codex executable does not exist.
无法运行所选的 Codex 程序。: The selected Codex executable could not run.
